answer.text: The page lists 3,000 yen per person for an on-the-day cancellation, whether or not notice is given (the day-before fee is 2,000 yen). It also notes that same-day cancellations or guest-count changes "may incur a 'cancellation fee.'"

citations.quote: On-the-day cancellation (with notice): 3,000 yen (same as above)
◆Cancellations or changes in the number of guests on the day of your visit may incur a "cancellation fee."
